claims.text: Mavyret: acute or chronic HCV GT 1-6, w.o cirrhosis or w compensated (Child-Pugh A), age ≥3;
claims.quote: MAVYRET is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients 3 years and older with acute or chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) genotype 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 infection without cirrhosis or with compensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh A).
